answer: A bond is refunded only after 36 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The bridge counter is kept in meadow and basalt shows each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 36 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2396 identities would post 2877 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
